changelog:
- Initial release of CCTV News Fetcher skill.
- Fetch summary titles and content from CCTV News Broadcast (Xinwen Lianbo) for any given date.
- Supports relative date queries like "yesterday" or "today".
- Parses and summarizes news, grouping by Domestic and International when possible.
- Requires bun runtime and node-html-parser dependency.
summary: Fetch and parse news highlights from CCTV News Broadcast (Xinwen Lianbo) for a given date.
